reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "loki otel: Add support for per tenant configuration for mapping otlp data to loki format 11143", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: New optional capability for per-tenant OTLP-to-Loki mapping; the evidence states no operational impact.

proposed.statement: Loki adds support for per-tenant configuration of how OTLP data is mapped to the Loki format.
